information_contract: All policies receive the same risk interval, 12 nodes, 24 scenario ensemble, consequence weights and budget. Adaptive methods receive each simulated binary result only after test selection.
claim_boundary: Surface-water microbial context and simulated Net3 reach are separate evidence tracks. No paired drinking-water E. coli, real-city performance, or field validation.
negative_result_rule: No superiority claim unless the paired 95% interval is above zero; equivalence is reported separately.
certificate_boundary: Initial next-test regret bound only, conditional on enumerated scenarios and risk interval; not a biological or real-world safety certificate.
